scope: OFFLINE_DIAGNOSTIC, static_0 and lt_changes_0 only, first 0-10s; no estimator/ROS startup
time_origin: first official GT stamp independently per sequence
scan_selection: nearest original front scan whose stamp lies within [GT0,GT0+10]; ties earlier stamp; no score-based selection
trajectory_centers: GT/A0/A1/A2 at exact scan time by linear XY and quaternion SLERP, no spatial fit or extrapolation; unavailable center explicitly omitted

grid.union: exact float64 pose triples, duplicates removed; center grids retained separately for widths and ESS proxies

beam_indices: 0,9,...,810: all 91 physical slots; common validity and pz for both aggregations

model.A1: sum(log(pz)) preserved in log domain; normalized ratios only within model
model.beam_skip: NOT applied; historical A2 masks/particle population unavailable; A2 is candidate pose only

validity: native amcl_node min/max remapping and sensor max/NaN exclusion
sector_coordinates: original laser scan bearing, not global map or candidate-specific sectors
grid_proxy: ESS and half-height XY profile width computed only within uniform GT-centered grid; not actual PF ESS or calibrated uncertainty
sample_geometry_bins: <=0.2m GT-near, >0.6m outside 3 initial xy SD, >1m severe; descriptive not changed historical failure definition
peak: finite candidate set only, not full-map optimum
decision_boundary: concentration alone does not prove wrong localization; GT support alone cannot prove actual PF particles included it
